stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while H2 (minimum distinct vegetable types) was only partially recovered; its broad question about 'minimum quantity requirements' did not clearly target the count-of-distinct-types constraint, so this P1 slot remained unresolved at stop.

summary: The agent clearly resolved the protein purchase-unit question (H1) and the budget/weight hard-constraint checks, but only obliquely probed the minimum-vegetable-types rule (H2) with a vague quantity question before declaring READY_TO_MODEL, leaving a P1 slot not cleanly confirmed by the agent's own questioning.
